evidence.detail: current whois_mtgo() returns only the Discord mention for the MTGO name — no stats, Elo, season count, archetype, or tournament data
Person view has decks, archetypes, achievements, trailblazer cards but no narrative pen-picture sentence generation
no pen_picture or player summary function found anywhere in the codebase
Comments from bakert show draft narrative sentences ('bakert99 (Elo 1976) has played 30 seasons...') as desired output, confirming the feature is not yet implemented

triage.notes: The feature requires aggregating Elo, season count, top archetypes, PD500 results, tournament wins, and league 50-0 data into a narrative sentence for both the bot (whois) and a decksite page. Multi-component new feature with design decisions on format and scope.
